question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Merrill's Advisor Development Program (ADP) trains new financial advisors to build their books of high-net-worth clients, attract and build client relationships, and progress to a Merrill Core Advisor (FA) role equipped to help clients pursue their financial goals.
items.quote: Roles are designed to enhance your ability to meet and help clients identify financial goals, align banking and investing solutions and build your book of high-net worth clients... Progress through three roles until you graduate to Merrill Core Advisor... Upon progression to Merrill Core FA you have completed the Advisor Development Program and now possess the skills and capabilities to help clients create and implement plans to pursue their financial goals.

items.text: Merrill's Bank of America CFO said the firm is training people in wealth management at Bank of America and Merrill, and that improving net new flows is what it is ultimately trying to drive.
items.quote: it's a training program so that we're training people in wealth management, Bank of America, and Merrill, and that's ultimately what we believe we can just keep driving in order to improve the net new flows.

items.text: Merrill's CFO said the firm attracts talent across both new and experienced advisers and continues to focus on adviser productivity and long-term client relationships.
items.quote: We remain focused on pricing discipline, adviser productivity and long-term client relationships. We're driving productivity higher on both newer and existing members of our financial advisers team, and we continue to attract talent across both new and experienced advisers.

items.text: Merrill's CFO said the firm added financial advisors to the sales force in Merrill and the Private Bank through its extensive training program and experienced hiring of advisors, with about one-third of net new households in Q2 added by newly trained advisors.
items.quote: We also continued to add financial advisors to the sales force in Merrill and the Private Bank through our extensive training program and experienced hiring of advisors. Approximately one-third of net new households in Q2 were added by our newly trained advisors.

items.text: Merrill's CFO said the firm has returned to veteran broker recruiting (after pulling back at the end of 2017), and that recruited assets to the wealth unit doubled year-over-year.
items.quote: Merrill executives in October touted that recruited assets to the wealth unit doubled year-over-year as the firm has returned to veteran broker recruiting.

items.text: Merrill's CFO said adviser attrition is now at near historic lows, and that the firm is focused on continuing to grow the sales force.
items.quote: So I think what Lindsay and Eric are trying to drive there, what Katy is trying to drive there is just keep growing the sales force. Well, adviser attrition is now at near historic lows.

items.text: Merrill's president and co-head Eric Schimpf said the firm will continue to invest in AI and digital capabilities to support advisors and deliver personalized advice, including new AI-enabled tools that help advisers prepare for client conversations and identify opportunities.
items.quote: While the Merrill executive did not mention new AI tools, the message was clear that the firm would continue to invest in AI and digital capabilities.

items.text: Merrill's CFO said the firm's new AI-enabled tools help advisers prepare for client conversations, identify opportunities and deliver more personalized advice at scale, expanding capacity to deliver personalized advice at scale.
items.quote: Advisor productivity, disciplined pricing, digital engagement and AI tools continue to expand our capacity to deliver personalized advice at scale.

items.text: Merrill's foundational belief states that having the best advisors enables them to deliver exceptional client outcomes, and that the Wealth Continuum allows delivering for every client in the way they want to be served.
items.quote: …having the best advisors enables us to deliver exceptional client outcomes …we have the capabilities to deliver for every client in the way they want to be served

items.text: Merrill offers a suite of tools, a client-first planning process powered by Merrill exclusive planning technology, and robust solutions for ultra-high-net-worth clients including alternative investments and sustainable and impact investing.
items.quote: A client-first planning process, powered by Merrill exclusive planning technology and powerful analytics to visualize your finances... Robust solutions for ultra-high-net-worth clients, including alternative investments and sustainable and impact investing strategies

items.text: Merrill launched Tax Efficient Transition Service (TET), designed to help clients transition appreciated securities into a managed investment strategy over time while managing the realization of capital gains.
items.quote: TET is a service designed to help clients transition appreciated securities into a managed investment strategy over time. The service uses a structured approach to help clients move toward their target allocation and selected investment strategy, while managing the realization of capital gains.

items.text: Merrill's co-head Jay Link said the new TET and DCA services help clients stay focused on their long-term financial goals by helping transition appreciated assets without realizing all the tax impact at once and investing cash without timing the market.
items.quote: These services help clients to stay focused on their long-term financial goals.

items.text: Merrill's CFO said the foundational belief that growth of fully advised client relationships drives financial outcomes and the resilience of the business model creates enduring shareholder value.
items.quote: …growth of our fully advised client relationships drives financial outcomes …the resilience of our business model creates enduring shareholder value

cells.reason: Passages describe Merrill's preparation for generational wealth transfer through advisor training, hiring, advisor productivity, digital/AI investment, planning technology, and tax-efficient transition services; these are statements of approach, not a single numeric quantity, so they are facts about how Merrill prepares.
